beats.visual: Two app windows; a hand-cursor drags rows back and forth, rows pile up
beats.motion: rows slide in one by one, faster each time, then jam

beats.visual: Clock icon; the minute hand sweeps, small calendar squares fill grey
beats.motion: clock hand sweeps once, calendar squares stagger-fill

beats.visual: The two windows join with a single bold line; accent colour appears for the first time
beats.motion: windows drift together, line draws on, accent fills the connector

beats.visual: Rows flow along the connector; checkmarks land on both windows
beats.motion: rows travel the path at constant speed; checkmarks pop with a small settle

beats.visual: Logo lock-up on the brand background, URL below, everything still
beats.motion: fade in, then hold with no movement
